svg.title: Technology toolkit: ten rows of floating icons
svg.desc: Languages: Python, C++, Java, JavaScript. ML: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn. AI: LangChain, Hugging Face. NLP: spaCy, NLTK, Transformers. Computer Vision: OpenCV, PyTorch, torchvision. Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Pinecone. JS Frameworks: React, Next.js. Deployment: AWS, Azure. LLMs: Claude, Codex, Ollama, Hugging Face. Tools: Git, Jupyter, Anaconda, GraphQL, CUDA.
